title: The managed ZIP index defers its 64 KiB locator scratch until a fixed EOCD probe misses
code_state: crates/soapberry-zip only: locator.rs, office.rs and directory_prefill.rs; no public API, error kind, archive limit, ZIP record or output member changed; no unsafe and no new dependency
authority: change 0651 row 18, change 0632's locator-scratch limitation, and change 0652's correctness-first standing decisions
reason_codes: the managed IndexedArchive::from_reader* path allocated a 64 KiB locator scratch before its mandatory fixed terminal-EOCD probe, even though the common zero-comment shape can decide the locate from a 22-byte read

a 46-byte stack buffer is sufficient for the fixed EOCD and the existing first-central-record probe; a missed probe allocates the historical 64 KiB buffer with try_reserve_exact before the unchanged backwards search
the public ZipLocator defaults keep directory prefill disabled, so callers that supply their own locator scratch retain their existing request and buffer behavior
the common path's allocation removal is measured directly, while the missed path is covered by focused comment, ZIP64, prefix, short-read and malformed-directory tests and the full open oracle

accepted_evidence.allocation_probe: change 0632's probe, release builds on CPU 8, three fixtures: open allocations 5338->5337, 1995->1994 and 403->402; allocated bytes 2256370->2190833, 541256->475719 and 365976->300439; open requests, bytes and version observations identical
accepted_evidence.open_oracle: 533 containers from change 0632's list, 18494 report lines per leg, byte-identical reports, zero changed open-cost lines, and identical per-container request/byte/version costs
accepted_evidence.focused_tests: the directory_prefill integration suite covers the exact stack probe, missed comment search window, false EOCD comment signature, prefixed archive, ZIP64, capped short reads, undersized directory, oversized-variable-field BufferTooSmall refusal and empty archive
accepted_evidence.crate_suites: cargo test -p soapberry-zip --all-targets and cargo test -p litchi-opc --all-targets both pass with the requested two-job low-debug configuration

accepted_costs.missed_probe: comment-bearing, ZIP64, trailing-byte, malformed or otherwise rejected fixed probes still allocate the bounded 64 KiB fallback and use the established backwards search; no new request is added
accepted_costs.allocation_error_timing: a fallback scratch reservation failure still returns ErrorKind::Allocation with the existing indexed archive locator scratch resource, but it occurs after the small fixed probe because the reservation is deferred
accepted_costs.remaining_prefill: the central-directory prefill and the index's directory-sized scan buffer remain unchanged; this change removes only the locator's independent search scratch

known_gaps.latency: no latency, remote transport, physical-device, cold-cache or peak-RSS measurement was taken because the measured request grammar is unchanged
known_gaps.allocation_failure_injection: the deferred reservation failure path is typed and bounded but was not forced with an allocator-failure harness
known_gaps.corpus_missed_probe: the 533-container oracle exercises the corpus open grammar but contains no open-cost delta for the deferred scratch; the focused comment fixture supplies the missed-probe read-shape witness

withheld: any registered speedup, throughput, latency, cold-cache, physical-I/O, peak-RSS, instruction-count, concurrency-scaling, remote-source or cross-platform result
any claim that the deferred allocation changes malformed-input acceptance or refusal ordering beyond the focused tests and oracle evidence
